title: Manchester orb sized at 24 inches at most

tellings.quote: We did very detailed analysis 3D recreation of this thing from this exact viewpoints and using the the data there at the most 24 in.

plain: A glowing ball seen in the sky near Manchester Airport in England in 2024 was, at most, about 24 inches across. That is the finding of Mick West, a researcher known as a UFO skeptic, who says on the show that he and others built a detailed 3D model of the scene from the exact viewpoints and the available data. If he is right, the object was something small, not a large craft.
